# Vendored CMakeLists.txt for libass 0.17.5
#
# libass ships with Meson + Autotools only — no CMakeLists.txt.
# This file lives in renderer/third_party/libass-cmake/ and is added via
# add_subdirectory from renderer/CMakeLists.txt AFTER FetchContent populates
# the libass source. It locates the fetched source files through the
# libass_src_SOURCE_DIR variable (set by FetchContent, propagated to
# subdirectories by CMake's variable scope).
#
# Based on vcpkg's proven CMake port:
#   https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/blob/master/ports/libass/CMakeLists.txt
#
# Target: Windows x86_64 + MinGW GCC, DirectWrite font backend, no NASM.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(libass C)

# libass_src_SOURCE_DIR — repository root of the FetchContent'd libass source.
# Contains the libass/ subdirectory with all .c/.h files.
if(NOT DEFINED libass_src_SOURCE_DIR)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "libass_src_SOURCE_DIR is not set. This CMakeLists.txt must be added "
        "via add_subdirectory from renderer/CMakeLists.txt AFTER "
        "FetchContent_MakeAvailable(libass_src).")
endif()
set(LIBASS_SRC ${libass_src_SOURCE_DIR})

# === Generate config.h ==============================================
# Normally produced by configure (Autotools) or Meson. We hardcode the
# values for our fixed target — same pattern as vcpkg's config.h.in but
# via file(WRITE) to avoid needing a .in template.
file(WRITE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/config.h
"/* config.h - generated by vendored CMakeLists.txt - do not edit */\n"
"#ifndef CONFIG_H\n"
"#define CONFIG_H\n"
"\n"
"#define CONFIG_SOURCEVERSION \"cmake-vendored-0.17.5\"\n"
"\n"
"/* Font/text backends */\n"
"#define CONFIG_FREETYPE 1\n"
"#define CONFIG_FRIBIDI 1\n"
"#define CONFIG_HARFBUZZ 1\n"
"#define CONFIG_DIRECTWRITE 1\n"
"\n"
"/* ASM: disabled (no NASM). Pure-C fallback in libass/c/ is used. */\n"
"#define CONFIG_ASM 0\n"
"#define ARCH_X86 0\n"
"\n"
"/* Use large tiles for better rasterizer performance */\n"
"#define CONFIG_LARGE_TILES 1\n"
"\n"
"#endif /* CONFIG_H */\n"
)

# === Collect sources ================================================
# GLOB_RECURSE is required to pick up libass/c/ (pure-C SIMD fallback):
#   c_be_blur.c, c_blend_bitmaps.c, c_blur.c, c_rasterizer.c
# Matches vcpkg port and libass/meson.build source list.
file(GLOB_RECURSE ASS_SOURCES ${LIBASS_SRC}/libass/*.c)

# Exclude platform-specific font backends:
#   ass_coretext.c   — macOS CoreText only
#   ass_fontconfig.c — FontConfig not available/needed on Windows
list(FILTER ASS_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX ".*ass_coretext\\.c$")
list(FILTER ASS_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX ".*ass_fontconfig\\.c$")

# === Static library =================================================
add_library(ass STATIC ${ASS_SOURCES})

# C standard: gnu99 (matches Meson default_options c_std=gnu99)
set_target_properties(ass PROPERTIES
    C_STANDARD 99
    C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
    C_EXTENSIONS ON
)

# _GNU_SOURCE: required by MinGW for POSIX extension functions
# (matches Meson cc_features: -D_GNU_SOURCE)
target_compile_definitions(ass PRIVATE _GNU_SOURCE)

# -fno-math-errno: performance (matches Meson cc_features)
target_compile_options(ass PRIVATE -fno-math-errno)

# === Include directories ============================================
# PUBLIC  fetched-source/libass  -> ass.h, ass_types.h (consumers need these)
# PRIVATE binary dir              -> generated config.h (internal only)
target_include_directories(ass
    PUBLIC
        ${LIBASS_SRC}/libass
    PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}
)

# === Link dependencies ==============================================
# All deps are PUBLIC because `ass` is STATIC — the final executable
# must resolve every external symbol referenced by libass objects.
#
# Pre-built targets from T1/T2 (already available in the CMake tree):
#   freetype   — FreeType (plain target; Freetype::Freetype namespace only
#                exists via find_package, NOT FetchContent add_subdirectory)
#   harfbuzz   — HarfBuzz (plain target from FetchContent)
#   fribidi    — FriBidi (plain target, PUBLIC FRIBIDI_LIB_STATIC propagates)
#
# Windows system libs:
#   gdi32  — GDI font enumeration (required by DirectWrite backend)
#   dwrite — DWriteCreateInstance COM factory (required at link time)
if(WIN32)
    target_link_libraries(ass PUBLIC
        freetype
        harfbuzz
        fribidi
        gdi32
        dwrite
    )
else()
    target_link_libraries(ass PUBLIC
        freetype
        harfbuzz
        fribidi
        m
    )
endif()
